issue.body:
Hi.

While adding OpenAPI to my Starlette application I noticed that the SchemaGenerator does not seem to pick up subdomain routes registered with Host() as described in docs here: https://www.starlette.io/routing/#host-based-routing

There seems to be lacking functionality to pick up the routes of a Host group here: https://github.com/encode/starlette/blob/master/starlette/schemas.py#L51

Here is a small application demonstrating the issue: 
**requirements.txt**
```
anyio==3.6.2
apispec==5.2.2
click==8.1.3
h11==0.14.0
idna==3.4
packaging==23.0
python-dotenv==1.0.0
PyYAML==5.4.1
sniffio==1.3.0
starlette==0.26.1
starlette-apispec==1.0.5
uvicorn==0.21.1
```

**example.py**
```python
from starlette.applications import Starlette
from starlette.routing import Host, Mount, Route, Router
from starlette.responses import HTMLResponse, JSONResponse
from starlette.schemas import SchemaGenerator
from pprint import pprint
import uvicorn
import yaml
import sys

spec = {
    "openapi": "3.0.0", 
    "info": {
        "title": "Example API", 
        "version": "1.1"
    }
}
schema = SchemaGenerator(spec)


# /openapi.json schema
async def openapi(request):
    return schema.OpenAPIResponse(request=request)

# Show docs /api
# FIXME: Redoc not showing "Try it out" button for some reason
async def docs(request):
    html = f"""
        <!DOCTYPE html>
        <html>
          <head>
            <title>Redoc</title>
            <meta charset="utf-8"/>
            <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
            <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css?family=Montserrat:300,400,700|Roboto:300,400,700" rel="stylesheet">
          </head>
          <body>
            <redoc spec-url="{request.url.scheme}://{request.url.netloc}/openapi.json"></redoc>
            <script src="https://cdn.redoc.ly/redoc/latest/bundles/redoc.standalone.js"> </script>
          </body>
        </html>
    """
    return HTMLResponse(html)

# GET /users
async def list_users(request):
    """
    responses:
      200:
        description: A list of users.
        examples:
          [{"username": "tom"}, {"username": "lucy"}]
    """
    raise NotImplementedError()

# GET /users
async def get_user(request):
    """
    tags:
      - User Management API
    parameters:
      - name: username
        in: path
        type: string
        required: true
        description: The username of user you want info for
      - name: size
        in: query
        type: integer
        description: size of awesomeness
    responses:
      200:
        description: Info about the user
        examples:
          [{"username": "tom"}]
    """
    username = request.path_params['username']
    print(username)
    raise NotImplementedError()


# POST /users
async def create_user(request):
    """
    responses:
      200:
        description: A user.
        examples:
          {"username": "tom"}
    """
    username = request.path_params['username']
    print(username)
    raise NotImplementedError()


ROUTES = [

    Route("/users", endpoint=list_users, methods=["GET"]),
    Route("/user/{username}", endpoint=get_user, methods=["GET"]),
    Route("/users/{username}", endpoint=create_user, methods=["POST"]),
    
    Route("/openapi.json", endpoint=openapi, include_in_schema=False),
    Route("/api", endpoint=docs),
    
    # Include host based routing as described in docs: https://www.starlette.io/routing/#host-based-routing
    # Problem: These routes are not included by the SchemaGenerator and therefore not visible in the OpenAPI spec
    # https://github.com/encode/starlette/blob/master/starlette/schemas.py#L51
    Host("subdomain.example.org", name="sub", app=Router(routes=[
        Mount("/foousers", name="foousers", routes=[
            Route("/", get_user, name="get_user"),
            Route("/{username}", create_user, name="create_user")
        ])
    ]))

]

# Debug print routes
pprint(ROUTES)

app = Starlette(routes=ROUTES)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    assert sys.argv[-1] in ("run", "schema"), "Usage: example.py [run|schema]"

    if sys.argv[-1] == "run":
        uvicorn.run(app, host='0.0.0.0', port=8000)

    elif sys.argv[-1] == "schema":
        schema = schema.get_schema(routes=ROUTES)
        print(yaml.dump(schema, default_flow_style=False))
```

Accessing the OpenAPI documentation at `/api` shows the following three routes only, and none of the subdomain routes from the Host() group:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16032412/231132296-b4241a23-98ad-422a-89b8-b0d5b098618f.png)

Edit: there is also a chance I have made a mistake in my implementation causing this, as there are references to sub_endpoints in BaseSchemaGenerator, so please correct me if this is user error.
issue.title: Host() routes not included in OpenAPI Schema
